title: Explicit proper maps and transports between product-graph neighborhoods
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, and let $X,Y,U,U',P,P'$ be schemes. Let $a:X\to U$, $a':X\to U'$, let $e:U\hookrightarrow P$ and $e':U'\hookrightarrow P'$ be open immersions, and let $p:P\to Y$ and $p':P'\to Y$. Given a proper $r:P'\to P$, a map $q:U'\to U$, a Cartesian square $re'=eq$, and equalities $qa'=a$ and $pr=p'$, define $L:R_aJ_eR_p\to R_{a'}J_{e'}R_{p'}$ by inserting the inverse direct-image compositor for $a=a'q$, applying the Cartesian proper/open exchange, then the compositor for $p'=rp$. Here $R$ denotes ordinary unbounded etale derived direct image and $J$ derived open extension [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] and [lem-sf-etale-locally-closed-graph-model]. Now fix a compactification $c$ of $f:X\to Y$ and presentations $s,t$ [def-pur-etale-graph-presentation-maps], with proper $pr:P_t\to P_s$, Cartesian open square $q,e_t,e_s,pr$, $a_tq=a_s$, and $pr p_s=p_t$. On products $T_i=P_i\times_Y c.Z$ [def-pc-fibre-product] define $r=(p_{1,t}pr,p_{2,t}):T_t\to T_s$. On the neighborhoods $O_{1,i}=T_i\times_{c.Z}X$ and $O_{2,i}=T_i\times_{P_i}U_i$, define $r_1=(b_{1,t}r,d_{1,t})$ and $r_2=(b_{2,t}r,d_{2,t}q)$. These squares over $r$ are Cartesian; $r$ is proper; $s_{j,t}r_j=s_{j,s}$ and $r(p_{1,s}p_s)=p_{1,t}p_t$. Define $D_j:R_{s_{j,s}}J_{b_{j,s}}R_{p_{1,s}p_s}\to R_{s_{j,t}}J_{b_{j,t}}R_{p_{1,t}p_t}$ by the same $L$ formula for $r_j,r$. All maps are the specified pullback lifts, and no choice of isomorphism is made. Schemes, open immersions and proper morphisms have the meanings of [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-open-immersion], and [def-weil-proper-morphism].

def etaleProperAmbientTransport
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Y U U' P P' : Scheme.{u}}
    (a : X ⟶ U) (e : U ⟶ P) (p : P ⟶ Y)
    (a' : X ⟶ U') (e' : U' ⟶ P') (p' : P' ⟶ Y)
    [IsOpenImmersion e] [IsOpenImmersion e']
    (r : P' ⟶ P) [IsProper r] (q : U' ⟶ U)
    (sq : IsPullback q e' e r) (ha : a' ≫ q = a) (hp : r ≫ p = p') :
    R((a)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]) ⋙ D((e)_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]) ⋙
        R((p)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]) ≅
      R((a')_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]) ⋙ D((e')_!open[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A]) ⋙
        R((p')_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} A])
